findings.one_line: The headline whole-fiber result is not substantively positioned against the cited Strieder--Drton structure-uncertainty confidence papers or Kato--Sasaki: add targeted relevance and theorem-level model/target/deliverable comparisons rather than leaving those closest entries only in the bibliography/comparator table.

This load-bearing lower-pair theorem lacks its own statement of what is new, why the exact-collision construction matters, and how it differs from the closest Meister and Belomestny--Trabs--Tsybakov lower-pair results; supply that theorem-level positioning.
